claims.statement: Body armours and two-handed weapons (bows, staves and warstaves included) hold up to 6 sockets; helmets, gloves and boots up to 4; one-handed weapons and shields up to 3.
claims.quote: The maximum number of sockets an item can have is determined by its type and item level. Helmets, Gloves, Boots can have up to 4 sockets; Chest armor and two-handed weapons up to 6; One-handed weapons and Shields up to 3.

claims.statement: A magic item holds 1 prefix and 1 suffix and a rare item 3 and 3; rare jewels and abyss jewels hold 2 and 2; flasks are never rare.
claims.quote: Converting a magic item to a rare is important for crafting in that a rare item has space for six affixes (three prefixes and three suffixes) while a magic item only has space for two affixes (one prefix and one suffix).

claims.statement: Tinctures follow flasks: at most 1 prefix and 1 suffix, and never rare.
